items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: So, he asked me, what would I like to play? I said, trumpet. He said, well you know they need trombone players, why don't you?

ctx.x: One of those things. So, my father said, you know they need trombone players. Trombones were scarce. That was the truth. They didn't have many trombones at that time. So, this fellow used to pass my house all the time. My dad knew him. And he said, why don't you teach that boy how to play an instrument. So, he asked me, what would I like to play? I said, trumpet. He said, well you know they need trombone players, why don't you? I'm going to take lessons on trombone. He said, I can give you some lessons. So, he…
That's a one-eyed trumpet? Yeah. That's right.
